book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Bikɛse ba gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bɛ Jiso bo fii wu
Ajiŋ a yu, Jiso ja wu jiɛnyi a bilaantɛŋ bɛ bantɛ le wu feeji saaka wù joŋe kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo. Booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛ ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ gɛ̀ bii wu le,

noo bikɛse bamu ba wu gɛ̀ fɛ binchɛŋ biboo bɛ bamu ba wu gɛ̀ bvusɛ biyo bì befe ye yiboo le. Bikɛse banɛ gɛ̀ bee Mɛɛle wù bo gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Madaleŋ, wù wu gɛ̀ bvusɛ banchɛndaa ba debele yi ye ye le bvusooshwi.
Nyume Joana wù jwɛɛŋ gɛ̀ bee Chusa wù gɛ̀ lɛne Hɛlod le, mo Susana bɛ bikɛse bamu wesee. Bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi noo, bo bvuse mwɛɛ a bikɛɛ biboo le, bo fii Jiso yu bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛ.
Ŋgaŋ kune muh wù gɛ̀ nooŋ muntaŋ
Bamii gɛ̀ ja bantɛ le bantɛ le bo too fɛ Jiso le. Kinchvu ki bamii gɛ̀ yisɛ fo, wu ma ŋgaŋ bo le lɛ.

content.text: “Muh gɛ̀ la ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu noŋ muntaŋ. Wu gɛ̀ doo wu nooŋ, mumu gweeyɛ a je, bamii fede bo jiɛnyi bɛ bikaa, munyii mù fuune we gɛ̀ tajɛ mu ji.
Mumu gwe fɛ kijusɛ ki ata le, lɛ mu doo mu buujɛ mu mo mu yunɛ nje kijusɛ kɛɛ gɛ̀ bee ki yɛŋe.
Mumu muntaŋ gwe yi mbiaŋ le, lɛ mu doo mu buujɛ mu kuu bɛ mbiaŋ yiyu, yi mo yi baŋe muntaŋ mwɛɛ lɛ fɛ mu kuu gɛ.
Mumu gwe nyu yi nshɛŋ yì joŋe le, lɛ mu buujɛ, mu kuu, ba gɛ̀ gwejɛ mu bu kiŋgane gwii fede no ba gɛ̀ noŋ.”

content: No Jiso ma noo, wu mo wu jaŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù kɛme bintuŋ, wu yu.”

content: Fiɛɛ fì Jiso jɛme nyu a baŋgaŋ le
Booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ ja bo biih wu le laa ŋgaŋ wɛɛ duunyi lɛ la lɛ?
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Le bɛŋ ba Nyo le wu ge lɛ taŋlo bɛŋ kee mwɛɛ mu bvunfoŋ bwe mù le nyilɛ le. Geenɛ, bamii bamu yuge fiboo nyume a baŋgaŋ le. Fi le noo no fi gɛ̀ bee wa lɛ,
‘Bo lé bo gê bo jîiŋe gɛh lo mwɛɛ bo yɛde gɛ,
Bo yege gɛh lo bo yuge gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ.’

content: Fiɛɛ fì ŋgaŋ kune muh wù gɛ̀ nooŋ muntaŋ duunyi

content.text: Bɛŋ yu la fiɛɛ fì ŋgaŋ wɛɛ duunyi. Muntaŋ mwɛɛ le jɛ yi Nyo.
Muntaŋ mù gɛ̀ gwe a je, le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo debele mo wu to wu bvusɛ saaka wɛɛ a muntele muboo le, lɛ keefɛ bo bɛ̂ɛŋ bo tô bo lûŋ gɛ.

Muntaŋ mù gɛ̀ gwe fɛ kijusɛ ki ata le, le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo bo mo bo fi lo bɛ njoŋ, geenɛ yi baaŋ a chimɛ gɛ gɛŋ fɛ muntele muboo le gɛ, bo bɛmɛ gɛh nyu fɛmu fɛmu. Moŋ nɛ le wu to, wu mo wu chii bikaa.
Muntaŋ mù gɛ̀ gwe yi mbiaŋ le, le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo, bo doo bo gɛɛne, nfuuŋsɛ bɛ bvukugɛ mo njoŋ wu mwɛɛ mu yi kikfuuŋ le mo mu to mu yigɛ jɛ yiyu yi laayɛ lo yi ka kuu gɛ.
Muntaŋ mù gɛ̀ gwe yi nshɛŋ yì joŋe le, mu le bamii ba kɛme muntele mù njoŋe, ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo, bo mo bo lee lo muntele muboo yi le, bo mo bo kaane shɛ́ŋ, bo gee no yi goone bo gɛɛne lo fwe fwe.

content: Kin'yesɛ kì ba kfuusɛ bɛ ŋkaa

content.text: Gɛ muh to wu chu kin'yesɛ wu ka wu jo ŋkaa wu kfuusɛ yu gɛ. Gɛ taŋlo wu ka wu leesɛ tɛ agaguu gɛ. Wu to wu chu, kinʼyesɛ wu tome nyu yi fiɛɛ fì ba to ba toome kin'yesɛ fo, lɛ bamii doo bo lese yeh bo yɛde n'yuu le.
Fiɛɛ fichii fì le nyilɛ le, le fi nyu fi yɛne, mwɛɛ mù ajiŋ ajiŋ le mu bu n'yuu le.

Noo, bɛŋ doo bɛŋ yege jɛ yi Nyo bɛŋ mo bɛŋ yege yi chuule bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wù kɛme fiɛɛ lé ba nyû ba bîsɛ lo. Muh wù kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ mo nyu fì shige fì wu kwaji lɛ wù kɛme lo ba lé ba fî lo a wu le.”

content: Bamii ba le kfuu chi Jiso
No Jiso gɛ̀ yɛyi bamii noo, bwe Jiso bɛ booŋ ba bwe Jiso ja bo to lɛ bo yɛŋ wu le. Fi ya bo no bo lee nje kinchvu ki bamii gɛ̀ duude baaŋ.
Muh mu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Bwoo bɛ booŋ ba bwoo lɛme akfuuŋ bo goone ki bo yɛŋ wo le.”
Wu chvuu fie lɛ,

content.text: “Bwɛɛŋ bɛ booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ le bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo bo gee no yi goone.”

content: Jiso kɛme bvuŋga a we a nfuŋ bɛ joo
Lɛ ka nyu juu chimi, Jiso jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bee daŋ mamasi bee gɛɛŋ wuŋ kwege.”

content: Bo mo bo lee a ŋguh le bo daŋe.
No bo gɛ̀ daŋe, Jiso kɛ wu lefe. Nfuŋ ja wu kɛ wu shii, wu fuge joo bɛ bvuŋga joo lese a ŋguh le yi goone ki yi yîsɛ yo, bo nyu wa lo jwe wu kwe le.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo kaŋsɛ Jiso bo du lɛ, “Chiji Kikwɛɛ, Chiji Kikwɛɛ, bee le be kweeyɛ.” Jiso kaŋsɛ wu waŋ nfuŋ bɛ joo yì gɛ̀ fuge yiyu, nfuŋ wuyu lu, joo mo yi chii nɛ shiiŋŋ.
Wu biih bo le laa,

content.text: “Bɛŋ leese fitele nyu yi yɛɛŋ le mbɛŋ?”

content: Ye kuufɛ bo, bo kɛmɛ nfaaŋ bo ghaade lɛ, “Wunɛ le muh wù nɛɛ wù wanɛ nfuŋ bɛ joo mu yuge wu le?”
Jiso kɛme bvuŋga a we a banchɛndaa ba debele
Bo daŋ mamasi wɛɛ bo bu wuŋ kwege kimbe ki Gɛlasɛŋ le,
bo chinɛ wa kimbe ki woŋ kì Galalee le.

Jiso doo wu bude a ŋguh le, lɛ wu fɛsɛ kwa, bɛ muh mu wu a kinlaantɛŋ ki yu le tasɛ bɛ banchɛndaa ba debele bo fuuŋse wu. Bo che wa ye ye le baaŋ wu jiɛnyi kichinɛ kiyɛse, wu chee nyu afuuŋ yì ba gɛ̀ jiiyi bamii yo le. Wu ka chee gɛ fɛ yeh le gɛ.

No wu yɛŋ Jiso le, wu mo wu saa wu chinɛ kitada, wu gɛɛŋ wu gwe a wu jii, wu waŋ bɛ bvuŋga lɛ, “Jiso, Mwa Nyo, Nyo wu le Kikwɛɛ ki Mwɛɛ Munchii lɛ, wo goone la a mɛne? Kii kii, keefɛ wo nyâ mɛ ŋgɛ le gɛ.”

Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje Jiso gɛ̀ bee wu waŋ wa kiyo ki debele kiyu lɛ ki bû yi muh wuyu le. Ki to ki tu ki chuufe wù kiŋgane le kiŋgane le ba koode lo wu, ki ba koo ba kaaŋ chiaaŋ mo bikaa bɛ ncha fɛ ba tu ba chiɛɛne. Bo gɛ̀ kaaŋ noo, wu suume gɛh lo, kiyo kiyu mo ki chuufe wu, wu mo wu tu wu lege wu gɛɛne nchvuuŋ.
Jiso mo wu biih muh wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Jee chuŋ le yɛɛŋ?”

content: Wu chvuu lɛ, “Jee chaŋ le kinchvu.” Wu gɛ̀ chvuse noo nje banchɛndaa ba debele gɛ̀ bee bo chiiŋ lo yi ye ye le.
Banchɛndaa bayu lɛgɛ Jiso lɛ keefɛ wu chiiŋsɛ bo nyu a kintuge kì shiide nɛ ŋooŋŋ le gɛ.
Gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi munyuŋa yimi jii mwɛɛ yi mbɛɛsɛ le fo, banchɛndaa ba debele bayu mo bo lɛgɛ Jiso lɛ wu chiiŋsɛ bo bo boh bo gɛɛŋ bo lee nyu yi munyuŋa muyu le. Wu bɛɛŋ.
Bo mo bo bu ye yi muh wuyu le, bo daŋsɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo lee yi munyuŋa muyu le. Mu sɛŋ mu boh a kiŋkoŋ le, mu shii a mamasi wɛɛ le, mu kweeyɛ yo.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne munyuŋa muyu yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ le, bo ja fo, bo baa lo legɛ, bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ saaka wuyu a kilaantɛŋ bɛ bantɛ ba yo le.

Bamii tu bo yuge, bo bude bo gɛɛne ki bo yɛŋ tɛ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le. Bo to fɛ Jiso be bee fo, bo yɛŋ muh wɛɛ le, banchɛndaa ba debele baa chinɛ wa wu le, wu shii mbebe Jiso le, wu jii njú, bvufee bwe kaasɛ wa bvu tu fo. Bo faŋ baaŋ.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ le kɛ bo sɛŋe bo no fi gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ bɛ muh wɛɛ wu gɛ̀ kɛme banchɛndaa ba debele fɛ wu tɛmɛ.
Bamii bachii ba bimbe bì Gɛlasɛŋ le kɛmɛ faaŋ, bo mo bo chooŋɛ Jiso lɛ wu gɛ̂ɛne. Jiso mo wu ja fie, wu lee a ŋguh le lɛ wu gɛɛne,
muh wɛɛ wu banchɛndaa ba debele gɛ̀ bu yi ye ye le mo wu lɛgɛ Jiso lɛ bɛ wu gɛɛne. Jiso faŋ, wu chvuu wu jiŋ wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Wo gɛ̂ɛne nyu fɛ wo kfuuŋ, wo gɛ̂ɛŋ wo sɛɛŋ bamii buŋ fiɛɛ fì Nyo ge fɛ wo le.”

content: Noo, muh wɛɛ mo wu tu jiŋ wu gɛɛŋ wu jiɛnyi kinlaantɛŋ kɛɛ le kichii, wu sɛŋe kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ fì Jiso ge fɛ wu le.
Jiso kɛme bvuŋga awe a binchɛŋ bɛ kwe
Jiso daŋ mamasi, wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ kimbe kɛge le. Kinchvu ki bamii kì be shɛshɛ ki chiɛɛne wu fo fi wu.
Jwɛŋsɛ wumu gɛ̀ to fo ba tɛŋe lɛ Jailu, nyu chiji kikwɛɛ ki yeh yi buunɛ yi yo le. No wu to, wu fe wu gɛɛŋ wu tuŋ anyuu wu ŋgvuumɛ a Jiso jii, wu ku chiaaŋ lɛ wu to gɛh a wu yeh,
lɛ mwa ye kwee lo. Wu gɛ̀ kɛme mwa, ka gɛh wu maa, nyu mwa wù kwɛse wù nyu biluŋ yuufe ncho bifɛɛ. Bɛ Jiso ja bo gɛɛne kinchvu ki bamii faase Jiso.
Kwɛse wumu nyu a bo ntɛnɛɛ wù nyu wu chɛŋ wa bɛ kinchɛŋ ki bikɛse yi biluŋ le yuufe ncho bifɛɛ. Wu lɛsɛ wa fiɛɛ fichii fì wu gɛ̀ kɛme chiaaŋ yi bamii ba bifudɛ le, ki gɛ̀ ya bo ki bo fɛ.
Wu kɛŋsɛ wu to a Jiso jiŋ, wu kuŋ jwe wù nju yi Jiso le. Kimimia kinchɛŋ ke mo ki suunɛ.
Jiso biih lɛ,

content.text: “Kuŋ yɛɛŋ mɛne?”

content: Bamii bachii maŋe lo. Bita ja wu biih lɛ, “Chiji Kikwɛɛ, gɛ wo yɛde lɛ kinchvu ki bamii faase wo gɛ?”
Jiso duu gɛh lɛ,

content.text: “Muh le wu kuŋ mɛne. Nle yu no bvuŋga le bvu bu ye yaŋ le.”

content: Kwɛse wɛɛ yɛŋ lɛ gɛ je nyu yu yì taŋlo wu nyilɛ gɛ, njaŋ mo yi koo wu wu gɛɛŋ wu tuŋ anyuu a Jiso jii wu mo wu sɛɛŋ bamii bachii yu fiɛɛ fì be ge wu fɛ wu kuŋ Jiso le, wu ka wu sɛɛŋ no wu be kuŋ noo kinchɛŋ ke suunɛ lo kimimia.
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Mwa yaŋ, fitele fiuŋ fì wo lese yi ye yaŋ le, le fi ge wa wo tɛmɛ. Wo gɛ̂ɛne la chuule.”

content: Gɛh no Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme kwɛse wɛɛ le noo, muh mu fɛsɛ fo wu ja fɛ la chi Jailu wù chiji kikwɛɛ ki yeh yi buunɛ yɛɛ le, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Mwa yo le wu mɛsɛ wa. Keefɛ wo ka wo shê wo nyâa ŋgɛ Muh wu N'yɛyɛ le gɛ.”
Wu doo wu jɛmɛ noo, Jiso yu, wu jɛmɛ Jailu le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ wo fâane gɛ, lêesɛ gɛh nyu fitele fiuŋ yi ye yaŋ le maa, mwa yo lé wu tɛ̂mɛ.”

content: Bo mo bo ja bo gɛɛne fɛ Jailu kfuuŋ, lɛ wu doo wu gɛɛŋ wu fɛsɛ fo, Jiso faŋ lɛ muh yeh lee gɛ. Wu jo gɛh nyu Bita bɛ Jɛm mo Joŋ mo chiji mwa bɛ bwe mwa bɛ bo lee.
Gɛ̀ bee bamii yode lo fo, kwe fiee lo fo. Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ lû bɛ kwe, mwa wunɛ baaŋ kwe gɛ, wu lefe lo.”

content: Bamii ja bo tu bo keede lo wu fo, nje bo gɛ̀ kee chuule lɛ mwa wuyu le wu kwe wa.
Wu gɛɛŋ fɛ mwa wuyu gɛ̀ gime fo, wu jijɛ wu yi kibo le wu tɛɛŋ lɛ, “Mwa wù kwɛse, ja we!”
Wu mo wu kaasɛ wu tu yu, wu mo wu ja we kimimia. Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ ba jiŋɛ fiɛɛ ba nya wu wu ji.
Bwee bɛ chiji yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, jwe yuŋ bo. Jiso leh lo lɛ keefɛ bo sɛ̂ɛŋ muh fiɛɛ fì kooshi gɛ.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu tɛŋe lɛ Gadalɛŋ, bamu lɛ Gelegesɛŋ.
